title: Independent double-observer detections of Argali groups, Tost Local Protected Area, South Gobi, Mongolia, 2012-2013
creator: Tumursukh, Lkhagvasumberel; Suryawanshi, Kulbhushansingh R.; Mishra, Charudutt; McCarthy, Thomas M.; Boldgiv, Bazartseren
citation: Tumursukh, L., Suryawanshi, K. R., Mishra, C., McCarthy, T. M., & Boldgiv, B. (2016). Data from: Status of the mountain ungulate prey of the endangered snow leopard Panthera uncia in the Tost Local Protected Area, South Gobi, Mongolia [Data set]. Dryad. https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.v61m2
abstract: Double-observer surveys of argali in the mountain blocks of the Tost Local Protected Area (South Gobi, Mongolia) in 2012 and 2013: two observers searched independently and every group either detected was recorded with its size and with which observer saw it. 11 groups (85 animals) in 2012 and 22 groups (165 animals) in 2013. The authors estimate groups and population size with the Forsyth-Hickling / Suryawanshi double-observer estimator; prey of the snow leopard.
samplingProtocol: Independent double-observer survey of mountain ungulates (Suryawanshi et al. 2012): two observers walk the same route separated in time so neither cues the other, record every group with its size, and groups are matched afterwards on size, composition and location.
surveyEvidenceNote: Each deposited row is a group seen by at least one observer; both observers surveyed it, so all three detection cells are defined. Groups missed by both observers are not in the deposit by design.
closure: occasion (the three detection cells of one group within the year's survey); groups are not matched across years
geographicCoverage: Tost Local Protected Area, South Gobi province, Mongolia (about 43.1 N, 100.6 E); no coordinates deposited
notes: Unit = a detected group (id = year_row). y = 1 in the group's detection cell, 0 in the other two; unit_group_size = animals in the group. To recover the authors' cell counts sum y by period and occasion; the population estimate multiplies estimated groups by mean group size. Sibling table: tumursukh_2016_tost_ibex_dobs (components).

notShipped.estimates: Output sheet columns E-F: estimated groups, mean group size, population, variances and detection probabilities (model output)
notShipped.back_end_calculator: intermediate sums for the variance of mean group size (derived)
notShipped.demographic_surveys: the paper's ibex sex-ratio and young-survival surveys are not in the deposit
